other_failure_modes.name: Look-ahead bias via future features
other_failure_modes.description: Creating 'lead' features (shifting data backwards from the future) on exogenous variables. While the test set technically provides these columns, relying on future information to predict current states creates a model that cannot be used in a real-time production setting without an oracle or perfect forecasts.

summary: The agent builds a very sophisticated solution featuring extensive domain-specific feature engineering, a deep learning model, and an optimally weighted ensemble. However, it critically fails to respect the temporal nature of the time-series data. By using a randomized K-Fold cross-validation strategy and incorporating 'lead' features that look into the future, the solution suffers from look-ahead bias and substantial data leakage.
